tools.description: Creates a one-time bluerate.ai link (confirmationUrl, valid for 24 hours) for asking a loan officer listed on bluerate.ai to call back. The person who wants the call opens the link, enters their own phone number and email, agrees to be contacted and submits; only then is the loan officer notified. Phone numbers and email addresses are not accepted here. Takes the loan officer's NMLS ID and, optionally, the person's name, state and loan purpose to prefill the page.

borrowerName.description: The user's name, if they gave it, to prefill the page. They can change it there.

nmls.description: The loan officer's NMLS ID, digits only: the nmls field of a search result or profile.

state.description: The US state of the property, two-letter code, for example CA.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.title: Request a call back from a loan officer

tools.description: Searches licensed US mortgage loan officers listed on bluerate.ai by state, optionally near a city or ZIP code, for a loan type (conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, non-QM, home equity: HELOC or home equity loan) or by a language they speak. Returns up to 10 loan officers, each with name, NMLS ID, company, office city, licensed states, loan types, languages, number of reviews and url: the loan officer's public bluerate profile, where people read reviews and request a callback. Also returns total (how many match) and moreResultsUrl (the full list on bluerate). Results are filtered by state license, not office location; city and zip only rank nearby offices first. Results contain no phone numbers or email addresses.

city.description: City name, for example San Jose. Puts loan officers with an office there first; does not filter.

language.description: A language the loan officer speaks, as a name (Spanish, Chinese) or a code (es, zh).

limit.description: How many loan officers to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

loanType.description: Only loan officers who do this loan type in the state. home_equity is a HELOC or home equity loan. Leave it out for every loan type.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code, for example CA or TX. Full names like California also work.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, for example 94105. Puts loan officers with an office there first; does not filter.
